title: Polaris Sprints
subtitle: 90-day execution sprints using hybrid agile patterns, RACI matrices, and Capital Velocity Audits to unlock working capital.

sections.heading: Hybrid Agile Execution Cycles
sections.body: Polaris Sprints™ combine high-velocity Scrum/Kanban cycles for product development with gated milestone patterns for regulatory governance. This dual-layer approach allows teams to iterate rapidly while maintaining full auditability.

sections.heading: Capital Velocity & Bottleneck Removal
sections.body: Applying Theory of Constraints (TOC) and RACI matrices, each 90-day sprint targets working capital bottlenecks. We shorten operational lead times, optimize Cash Conversion Cycles (CCC), and accelerate path-to-market.
